title: 36 Hours in Ibiza, Spain
abstract: Whether it’s hibernating in yoga retreats or lounging by turquoise blue water and white-sand beaches, Ibiza offers plenty of laid-back after-party spots.

title: 36 Hours in Marrakesh, Morocco
abstract: Every generation, Westerners find new reasons to go gaga for Marrakesh. These days, it is emerging as the center of North Africa’s style and night life.

title: 36 Hours in San Sebastián
abstract: This laid-back surfing resort is not for weak-willed dieters; there are sweet-smelling cafes and mouth-watering bites to tempt you at every turn.

title: 36 Hours in Oaxaca, Mexico
abstract: Although it’s known as a hotbed for social justice rallies, Oaxaca’s infectious zeal goes far beyond the political, spilling into all its pursuits.
